property_summary: For any address a, a successful DrugDealer call by a must make a the new CEO (c.ceoAddress() == a); the mutant, which deletes the assignment, keeps ceoAddress unchanged so a caller that succeeds without becoming CEO violates the rule.

For any caller, a successful DrugDealer call must (re)establish that the caller holds the CEO role, i.e. c.ceoAddress() == msg.sender; the mutant deletes the assignment so the CEO anchor can silently drift from what a successful call guarantees.

For any caller who is the current ceoAddress, a successful DrugDealer call must leave ceoAddress unchanged (set to msg.sender, which equals the current CEO); the mutant sets it to address(0), breaking this for any such caller.
